body: ADR-222 gave the gateway if_stamp and expires_at and no operator could send either; blind_console now carries both in _meta, only when a move names them, so a plain call is unchanged. The sixth blind trial spent them on four pages no blind operator had touched -- greenhouse, soil bench, survey design, tree visualizer -- one attempt each, 55 of 78 outcomes and 239 of 285 claims in 171 calls. Every operator guarded its irreversible act with if_stamp and the door's refusal is in the trace: a stamp the target moved past refused stale on all four, a past expires_at refused expired, and after the guard the act ran. Found: every operator confused the report's inner stamp with the door's outer snapshot stamp (the next slice); and tree-visualizer makes 28 nodes where the task holds 24 because its random button draws until a key is new (filed). verify_mcp 93 to 98, verify_tasks 392 to 411, mutate_contract 103 to 105.
subject: ADR-228: the two things a command says about itself, given to the operator at last -- and the first four science pages no blind operator had ever driven
